notes.title: Weekly Winner - October 10th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/118e9d2dd7038f219f67d7906bfed3b5ca8f2904.png[/img]
Read on and find out more about latest (and hopefully not spooky) Workshop submissions:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2872781179 

A sequel to https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2865514365 and a lot more frantic one at that :) A bit of a lucky start would be welcome-it's a Passenger Flow train valley after all-, but it isn't a particularly difficult puzzle per se. Rather, everything happens so fast and at such a high speed you will be better off restarting in case something goes less than optimal. Try avoiding building a tunnel for additional challenge, 12:00, DNRT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2871055730 

A triple sequel to https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2629058901
The Vengeance of DooM could strike at any moment, all is not what it seems and numbers mean nothing. Terraforming actively sabotaging your railway network, at least 10 000 000 TV2$ to accrue, connecting every industry and designing junctions in very limited spaces, not getting spooked-there is a lot to take care of and only 35:30 on the timer. 
Granted, there is an Easy version https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2871837939 - earn just 5 000 000 TV2$, build 5 or more tunnels, same timers -
with faster funds accumulation and altered layout that offers a warmup of sorts while hinting at possible ways of solving the original. 
And then there's https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2871856440 with same requirements as Easy yet a bit different layout from the first two variants. Hard in several ways, DooM's Revenge offer that sense of satisfaction that comes with finishing something challenging.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2872964873 
Planning train routes and optimizing your deliveries schedule while watching your shiny engines drive back and forth right through the evil pumpkin’s seeds and slimy stuff-welcome to Evil Pumpkin's Hub :) Tracks inside the spooky vegetable lantern are independent, there's 16:00 on the timer and the Spider factory is waiting for another Potatoes shipment. A fun, replayable, LPT'ed adventure.

notes.title: Weekly Winner - October 3rd
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/f963df9939f33cfb3258235cfcf90a27f3fb75a7.png[/img]
We hope the autumn season is treating you well. Let's talk Workshop levels.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2870390562 

An attempt to keep Workers in the supply chain as much as possible, Worker Recycling trades decorations for increased resistance to being solved at the first attempt-a 20:00 excercise in not reversing your trains, navigating numerous Disassembling Factories and counting your resources :) 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2869056033 

We are to look for a way to raise additional funds. Delivery quests, supplying every industry in the valley with Workers, taking your freshly emitted Bonds to the Bank, not upgrading the engines-in an economy like that a 2 tunnels limit and no train crashes seem like very reasonable objectives.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2869312544 

This time around Toll Stations prevent us from earning a single TV2$ for delivering Workers to an industry. A finely tuned puzzle with resources coming in batches of 5 and easy to track Market prices-an economy that is easy to ruin by overspending yet quick to analyze and find thy error, a Power shortcut worth investing into during later stages of the game and terraced layout that visually separates the valley and presents an extra railway track planning task. There's a 128 track limit in effect, no demolition jobs allowed and a 18:00 timer. LPT'ed. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2869475686 

A colourful maze-looking puzzle of many delivery quests, free renewable Power, generous 35:00 timers, hills unfit for tunnel construction that force us to work around them, zero tolerance for wrong deliveries and vanilla Train Valley 2 campaign vibes-almost feels like 2018 again :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2868347096 

A challenging journey to a blooming biotech paradise amidst the ruined scorched wastes. Surrounding communities expect Potatoes and Buggies-and hidden Hyperloop shortcut is just what one needs to restart local industry. Begin by accommodating 35 Passenger Flow trains, comply with the DNRT objective, keep the Oil flowing, explore additional routes and remember you only have 16:30 :) LPT'ed.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2867789288 

A Christmas before actual Christmas? Where do I sign? :) We need to boost candy output rates in a secret candy production facility located right next to what looks like the biggest gingerbread house on the planet. It's 10:30 on the timer-and we do not have time for engine upgrades or demolition jobs; stock up on candies and punch and send these favorite Christmas treats everywhere using gingerbread container ships! A neat little adventure that goes well with a cup of hot chocolate :)

Great job @LittleBear, your €10 Steam gift card is on its way! Please stand by for a message from our award distribution department.

notes.title: Weekly Winner - September 26th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/4d83ddf0a1c7e113ae89da66b9fa86dad4f201de.png[/img]

Welcome to Choo-Choo Weekly showcasing new Workshop inventions :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2865514365 

A fascinating Passenger Flow exercise with a twist - one of the stations is locked behind Customs gates! A Workers squad can unlock those for a time, so spend more points upgrading your Luck stat and hope you don't need that station too often :) 5:00, no wrong deliveries or train crashes.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2866815557

Time for an upgrade-local automotive crowd wants their old Cars replaced with shiny new high tech buggies. And some alien Artifacts too (fancy paperweights? adornments for new vehicles? We just don't know). Both factories need high volume heavy duty fast paced train deliveries-and you are one of the best in the trade. It might have been a while but it sure is a very enjoyable and LPT'able train valley :) 9:00, DNRT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2865017555 

You discover a bug-we find a way to fix it. You find a way to push our Editor's limits-we commend your effort. But when you do both, at the same time? :) Your typical supply chain is upside down-Cars, Tanks and Buses stockpiled, 7.5 Disassembling Factories ready to go and many delivery quests asking for resulting resources. Add a Customs Station, a Pass Limiter, a couple of building sites worth 1 500 000 TV2$ total, THE Electricity bug and a 20:00 timer-and you will get a different kind of puzzle with train juggling, wild resource managing and prioritizing and a very colourful valley to spend at least 3 500 000 TV2$
But not on demolition jobs :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2866212279 

Autumn is already here, but can one really argue with going somewhere by train in rainy weather? Nevermind Toll Stations, One Way Stations or Pass Limiters-deliver Buses, spare parts, fuel on time and restart that Natural Rubber Power station, navigate cololurful and moderately treacherous lands, avoid flooded areas, keep up with increasing pace-all the while thinking about ways to increase your efficiency and decrease your final times. 16:00, no wrong deliveries or train crashes.

Great job @Thomas, your €10 Steam gift card is on its way! Please stand by for a message from our award distribution department.

notes.title: Train Valley 2: Workshop Gems – Ruby is live on Steam!
notes.notes:
Dear adventurers,

We're happy to present the next content update for Train Valley 2: Workshop Gems – Ruby. 50 levels from Steam Workshop-reworked, rebalanced, redecorated, redesigned, rearranged and ready to go! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2098230/Train_Valley_2_Workshop_Gems__Ruby

We are close to 2000 user created levels in our Workshop-a trove of creativity, new ideas and beautiful designs that keeps Train Valley 2 moving forward and offers our players new challenge every day of the week. Having picked out some of the most played, discussed and subscribed to creations, we have devised several level packs-or Gems-and Flazm level designers Anton Antsiferov and Olga Rashkueva polished them just enough to make them shine brighter 🙂 The Ruby level pack is already out-check the Steam Store page link below!

This latest DLC is our thank you for honest, enthusiastic contribution and feedback, a way to support Flazm Interactive and our future projects, and another step in expanding Train Valley 2 presence on other platforms-including GOG, Epic Games Store, upcoming Playstation, XBox and Nintendo Switch releases along with Android and iOS ports.

Q. Will the original Workshop levels still be accessible after every level pack release?

A. Yes, you can still play original levels from the Workshop - we have preserved level names and completed every level's description with the creator's username.


Q. When will Train Valley 2 arrive to any of the gaming consoles/handhelds/operating systems/game launchers mentioned above?

A. We will keep you posted about any future developments, stay tuned to our Discord's #news channel.

notes.title: Weekly Winner - September 12th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/26c19fb57eed5ad5af680add1345d68154395e95.png[/img]Hello friends! Another week, another bundle of new workshop levels. Let's see!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2859311033
Very minimalistic, very conceptual. The gameplay is simple just like these geometric shapes. Well, almost.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2860624928
@thomas made a map with many squares and 12 terraforming events. It's a bit like Whac-A-Mole where the mole is your ready resources. Keep your eyes open.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2860688991
Gameplay according to the harsh laws of the Wild West: you will probably have to restart this level several times. You need gold and lots of beef. And try not to disturb the natives people.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2861867543
@Plastickbag made a great puzzle with three drivethrough counters. You must make some buses and related resources. The main thing is to cope with this intersection. Great job @Plastickbag, we're happy to give you a €10 Steam gift card!

See you next week, friends!

----

*Do No Stop Any Trains
*Do Not Destroy Any Track Tiles
*Do Not Reverse Trains
*Do Not Use Pause
*Do Not Upgrade Engines

notes.title: Weekly Winner - September 5th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/caee01d429d180014eb4f7a1ea4477532db57b0d.png[/img]
Hi all! The academic year has begun in most educational institutions of the world. Everyone is back from summer holidays and typical autumn weather has arrived in many countries. Perhaps you remembered TV2 for the first time in a long time and are wondering what's new there? The workshop always has something new, and we are pleased to tell you about it! Let's go!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2856146428 Make something new out of something old? Sounds like a trend! You can try it in @angryxpeh's new work. And to make the game more dynamic, there are 50 more passenger-flow-trains at your disposal.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2856958760 Breaking: Maestro @Dracken has made a beautiful map again! There is terraforming here, but you won't have to guess how exactly to start the movement of the platforms. The location of the "elevator operator" is indicated by huge gears, you will definitely find them.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2856112380 Leading the top three today is @BenGotham and his Civilization franchise. Everything is just the way you like it: cities require few resources, but you need to upgrade trains much earlier than you have enough money to do so. We really love it when we can play other games inside TV2! Thanks for your input @BenGotham, the €10 Steam gift card is yours!

As always, we are waiting for you at our LPT events. See you, friends!

notes.title: Weekly Winner - August 29th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/44ec29e4f7697557d67c4b0077b15bc45c48d4b4.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2852800775 

A quick 18:00 and simple DNDATT + DNST train valley, a perfect warmup for any aspiring train driving enthusiast :) Throw everything you have at local shortage of building supplies, choose the best bridge configuration and take those 5 stars home.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2855240648 

An island surrounded by dark waters, locals doing their best to build a sustainable economy, DNRT, 13:00 timer, and quite some ways to improve the Island's transportation network.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853059059 

Autotrains and terraforming events, lemonade rivers and Potato farms, last warm sunny days and more railway tracks to build-a perfect 15:00 + 4 engines limit train puzzle to brighten our welcoming of autumn.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2853217438 

Bear checkers-played by bears, with bears! Big prize includes Fish, Pumpkins, Teddy Bears and jars full of fresh honey. Facilitate necessary deliveries and oversee the tournament's grand finale-in less than 12:30 and with zero train crashes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/ee7356b65910c900864ff70f9d0ff2084331ba50.png[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2855170037

[i]Tasty, tasty, beautiful level. Can you smell the circus, reader? There’s peanuts…cotton candy…hot dogs…[/i]and a unique custom built design-an eerie looking amusement park of Passenger Flow routes, Potato Power Plants, autotrains, Pass Limiters and many industries bustling with delivery quests and fine details one will most certainly take time to marvel at. A 200 track tile limit along with a 15:00 timer and something (or someone?) moving at the edge of our peripheral vision will keep us alert and ready. Complex, beautiful, and now the Level Of The Month'August 2022 as well.

A second combo double win for @[b]Dracken[/b]-they take away both a [b]Level Of The Week[/b] and a [b]Level Of The Month[/b], congrachoolations! All the Steam gift cards will be delivered by our contact ASAP.

Tell us about your TV2 workshop adventures and visit our Discord server for an upcoming LPT challenge. Until next week!

notes.title: Weekly Winner - August 22nd
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/ff43f798db65bee851b6dad904672b8d822dd7bf.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2851418780 

A 20:00 minute timer that suggests avoiding placing tracks on water tiles as an extra challenge, a modest 15000 TV2$ demolition jobs budget and a steady supply of qualified Workers to man every industry there is. No crashing your trains.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2849888721 

Cargo containers, Disassembling Factories, investment opportunities, limited building space, track tile and bridge count, a central junction slowly turning into a railway maze-and a relaxed gameplay (but an LPT headache :) 12:30.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2850837102 

Fill the gap dividing the valley with everything you've got-Potatoes, Sand, Logs, maybe Cows too? Look out for many terraforming events, unaffordable Toll Station fees and possible shortcuts. 14:00. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2850995573 

Welcome to Potato Land where you can have potato-based dishes 5 times a day, live inside a giant potato and spend your time growing more potatoes! Deliver at least 88 trains, tame the Potato autotrain, complete 25 Passenger Flow deliveries, strike a deal with potato Customs officials and make potatoes flow. 18:00, don't buy more than 2 engines.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2850797771 

The terraforming will pave our way to new areas ready for total logistic overhaul, DNDATT and demolition crew on leave will keep things simple-we earn enough to open a second Workers depot and race against the 15:00 timer to deliver all the Copper Ingots and Candies this city needs.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2850336363 

DNRT + a 23:00 timer? Perfect! Your Microchips and Rockets and Computers factories with corresponding recipes may look imposing but start simple, accumulate raw resources and make your way up the supply pyramid-and soon you bank account will have more digits than you'll know what to spend on :) A thought-out layout with clever puzzle put right on top of it. Terraformingly funtastic!

Extending our cordial congratulations on winning the Level Of The Week award to @[b]rrc22[/b]! A €10 Steam gift card will be delivered by our contact ASAP.

Tell us about your TV2 workshop adventures and visit our Discord server for an upcoming LPT challenge. Until next week!

notes.title: Weekly Winner - August 8th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/068892ae73ada6f58ec8ef8d27c5114d1f63e2f3.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2843691097  

[i]It's not where you are going, it's where you've been.[/i]
BACD presents a new take on Passenger Flow train driving with tunnels taking your engines to the magical land of Offscreen and putting them back-but where? We have hints among the decorations, in the level's description and inside every train explosion :) DNDATT, 25:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2845485546 

100 train puzzles is no small feat, congratulations @thomas! Your hard work, perseverance, unique perspective and ability to find innovative ways to improve your train valley designs is the key to this success and many to come. Flazm Interactive is very impressed with the contribution you made to the Workshop and Train Valley community, thank you.
An easy one this time so we can celebrate too: navigate hilly terrain, accrue 1 000 000 TV2$ and build 10 (or more) tunnels in 18:00 (or less) minutes. Meet us and @thomas by the pool, thinking about new, better, Train Valley related content :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2845510051 

An ultimate 32:00 DNSAT test of your snack supplies and problem solving skills-maneuvering around multiple bodies of water with zero bridge building options and spending available funds carefully included, be it engine upgrades or funding the next 1 000 000 TV2$ factory construction project. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2843378301 

Setting up your train models and using everyday objects instead of train set props is a particular kind of fun :) Things like paper rolls, books, drawing supplies turn into stations, tunnels and mountains as soon as your first engine departs. 15:00 DNRT Hyperloop adventure right on top of your homework-just make sure you've done your equations.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2844544834 

Don't mind the kraken and friends chilling in the river right next to a mountain of very normal sized gold coins-with DNRT and 15:00 timer we barely have time to pay the desert city peoples with Sand (a possible quirk of local supply pyramid :) and other commodities so that they magically raise ground to support our megabridge across those peaceful, rainbow coloured waters-and then build our tracks into the Mushroom Forest, home of the Gigatree tribe.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2844928139 

A 185 track tiles limit, two 150 000 TV2$ Toll Stations placed in key access points (dragon and spider kingdoms having a minor disagreement), 17:00 and a flooded Farm to rescue. It's either coming up with the money or finding a way to smuggle resources out to keep everybody happy and unaware. Terrific execution of an interesting idea in a plausible setting.

We commend you on this latest success and look forward to seeing even more great creations from you @Plastickbag ! Keep up the good work!
A €10 Steam gift card will be delivered by our contact ASAP.

notes.title: Weekly Winner - August 1st
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/4f9ffa03bd4722c216e83f553eccb04cf2d71b62.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2840509343 

25 Passenger Flow ones and a single Coal delivery quest-with DNDATT and limited, heavily forested building space. And don't crash any of those 5 shiny fresh-out-off-the-line engines.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2841060398  

Sure, this one is just no wrong deliveries and no crashes, but the only delivery quest location is completely sealed off with just one way in and out-by the same mountain range that disconnects two key industries from the rest of the valley! That layout looks way easier and simpler than it plays :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2841593572  

60:00 DNSAT-and the only thing to do is funding new industries construction and driving your engines around using a ready railway network. The difficulty is to find the good path... the best path. A definitely refreshing experience considering starting amount of TV2$ :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2842141912 

Mysterious, inaccessible, other side on the Moon. Do we really have any idea about what's going on there? Teleporting sheep, a chunk of regolith missing that looks like someone or something decided to have a taste, flying space laser bears, crystal trees and booming industry that just posted a contract for dependable, heavy duty train delivery system. 20:00, no train crashing, many suspicious sounds.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2841421343  

Approaching 2000 Workshop levels, @unclekrusty decided to start the celebrations preemptively by publishing their 50th creation :) Congratulations on that incredible milestone, you have our gratitude and appreciation for your efforts over the years; your abilities and dedication to your craft have helped the success of our LPT challenges and TV2 community in general. We are already waiting for your 51st upload :) 
The Milestone Mixtape is on repeat and exactly 18 minutes long-with many advanced goods to produce and deliver across a busy, Passenger Flow trains-populated representation of a magnetic tape recorder. Hurry up and see what's on side B :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2841424352 

To start recycling huge piles of garbage lying around we need to make sure industrial machine is functioning-like clockwork. Taming the Workers autotrains, building around or mapping demolition tasks straight through somewhat expensive trash, avoiding train crashes and wrong deliveries-all in a 28:20's work.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2841065439  

We're playing hide-and-seek in a hedge maze with high-speed electric locomotives, finally! :) No reversing your trains, no wrong deliveries and absolutely no peeking; 45 Passenger Flow deliveries and a lot of presents to unpack and distribute among children-Books, Chocolate, Teddy Bears... If only that party lasted longer than 12:00 :)

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/ceea0a018b1f8f99979eb493ee9f7e4d67d13b4f.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2835216059 

The city wants Cars (yellow only for some reason), Bonds and Building Materials. Shallow waters surrounding it are no match for our diesel locomotives, so setting up a shortcut to the city's industrial district is a matter of funding. Very generous timers.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2833971450  

Inspired by a certain train board game this valley is full of Passenger Flow deliveries, grass patches that look like a code of some sort with a pattern to their colouring and a ban on destroying anything worth more than 1000 TV2$ or demolishing any track tiles-a clever design with 14:00, T2R Europe is here to steal our evening :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2836503425 

There is a blackout simulation planned at exactly 3:30, so you better get some potatoes by then, or try completing the level in 3:29 :) Don't forget about not destroying anything worth more 99 TV2$ too.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2834685966 

Terraforming divine intervention style, 20 Passenger Flow trains, local Torch industry in ruins and we are to somehow earn 750 000 TV2$ and then spend every last cent of it? Say no more, for we have 13:30 and unlimited restarts :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2835633388 

Those space conglomerates are squeezing every standard credit they can of any astronomical body they can land on-this martian colony has both heavy industry installations and tourist attractions right next to each other. We even have an engine limit of 5! Set up incoming supplies unpacking and redistribution, get the power Plant going and roll out Artifacts and Cyber Crystals autofactories, then go looking for that secret passage and save some credits by building less tracks :) A grand adventure with lots of twists and turns.

We're here to see through this underdeveloped valley's progress-with a twist: 5 trains have to enter a wrong station. No time to question our employer's motives, there's every staple resource any growing town requires to investigate, develop and utilize.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830968985 

A DNSAT Tier-1 ride to the Endeen Mountain valley where heavy industry supply chains have plenty of everything except logistic connections and local bridge building subcontractors are about to become very rich :)  

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830702804 

We have to win this valley back from deep waters, industry by industry, track tile by track tile. Quite some construction opportunities, Potatoes and Spiders-based recipes and one flying saucer later that 30:00 5-stars timer better be still ticking :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830078159 

A [Relax ver.] of https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816920723

With DNUP switched for a DNRT objective, the timer cut down to 13:00 and delivery quests' amounts adjusted this valley retains same enjoyable design and fine gameplay, a backstory including some Shinto-Buddhist folklore-and we get to visit the Temple of the Potato. LPT'ed.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2832333294 

Brimming with colourful crystals and Pass Limiter Stations, advanced Cyber Crystal and Yellow Buses factories and adapted to a subterranean lifestyle giraffes, Crystal Mountains is about going faster and faster for the next 15:30 :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2833403951 

Building tracks on the water is back on the menu! So is the most exotic Canned Goods recipe and a very novel way of combining some coloured letters into actual cash. Highly entertaining, DNDATT :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2830614038 

30:00, DNSAT, narrow streets to build on, 60 Passenger Flow trains scheduled, two delivery quest locations, industries to invest into and 55 000 TV2$ in our bank account-a challenge with a bit of everything. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2833135530 

A sequel to https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2811932683

that takes place in a birthday cake looking valley plagued by oversized pumpkins, symmetrical timers and a ban on any demolition jobs. Getting into that locomotive puzzle is way easier than getting out and not restarting :)

It's an expedition-for cow eggs! To get to the cow nest though you have to start a camp, find every spider, resupply your ship for a journey back home and start a cow farm! notes.title: Weekly Winner - July 4th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/3462d7ceee3cdfeda2e38a579926a09c5ee2dcbd.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2826971158 

A fine little puzzle to start off your Train valley run. 15:00, DNDATT, a Workers autotrain and terrain that both suggests routes to take and restricts one from taking the most obvious pathways.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2828974189 

Follow the existing railway tracks, upgrade your locomotives, reconnect Power and  take local Canned Food industry to the next level :) 13:20, no wrong deliveries and no crashing trains.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2827176900 

Spend at least 400 000 TV2$, crash at least 40 trains and try making some Bats deliveries while you're at it. 30:00, try completing that on at x2 game speed :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2828210007 

Six separate delivery quest locations and at least five Passenger Flow stations will test the limits of your preferred controller device :) The only bridge you can use-the only one that connects two parts of the river valley-will test your strategic thinking and scheduling skills too. 50:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2826790363 

Nothing like a contract somewhere at the North Pole in the middle of hot summer: below zero temperatures, no bridge building, ice fishing, trainspotting with polar bears, DNSAT and no need for AC :) 43:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2829920921 

We're building a first set of railway tracks for a newly invented steam locomotive, and to prove its financial viability we are to make it the most efficient and fast logistics network-which won't be too difficult since it is the first of its kind :) Earn at least 100 000 TV2$, DNSAT, 12:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2829372814 

Passenger Flow, track building, treacherous terrain and tight funding. DNRT, 19:00, spartan looks and many people counting on us to get around-on time.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2826879290 

Big city=big demands, and Train Valley 2 is almost never about things being easy :) The old oil pump jack will just not do-one of our objectives is to secure the oil platform and deliver oil via a tanker. Problem is the seaport is privately owned and has its own Customs station + this is a 21:00 DNSAT and DNDATT valley too :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2826693628 

Yes, yes we can power Mars with trees and potatoes. And we will :) Why not use both resources since we've learned how to grow that right here planetside? No Customs stations and restricted engine upgrading are enough to even slow our progress down, but detailed and colourful surroundings probably will steal our attention and some seconds off the 17:00 timer :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2828219596 

Build 40 bridges amidst constant terraforming of the Treasure Archipelago, your trains cruising just above the clouds, factories digging deep into levitating rock, unearthing magical artifacts, getting energy from the winds, steam powered airships moored and waiting for resupply. A charming design with adept execution, 13:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2829289487 

Unique approach to terraforming neatly decorated terrain-a valley divided into independent parts that require multitasking and are later to reunite and reinforce local industry, marvelous dynamics and a very enjoyable puzzle. 12:00, no destroying any fungi worth more than 2000 TV2$, LPT'ed.

An assortment of levels by @artemiyk20-simpler they look, better they play :) Introducing:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2823554296

One bridge to rule them all with quests and industries mixed and distributed on both sides of this river valley. Plenty of space for our tracks and very generous 50:00 timers to let us concentrate on bringing at least 700 000 TV2$ in. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2823919520

Constant stream of tourist filled Passenger Flow autotrains keeps railway schedules of this sakura grove valley busy and our job is to find some extra time to deliver and process and ship all that gold and gold related products :) 28:00, DNSAT and DNDATT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2823539150

Use the power of a nuclear power plant to set up car production. Use skilled train driving to deliver fuel for the plant and set up parts and resources deliveries for the automotive industries-after you invest money you've previously earned to construct those :) DNDATT, 36:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2825163013

Another valley waiting for investment, logistical upgrade and industrial prosperity. Mind the ruined railway track and start building industries and destroying 25 000 TV2$ worth of objects ASAP-we only have 35:00 on the timer :) 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2823620890 
and
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2823767014 

We're contracted to build a railway network on rapidly melting ice. In 13:00 or 16:00, while trying to locate and destroy object(s?) worth 40 000 TV2$ and not to crash a single train. Watch out for terraforming events and work around the Customs station. A refreshing challenge(s? :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2823998424 

A robust transportation infrastructure is missing around your freshly established trade hub and local work force is relying on shoddy outposts? Call 123-456-TV2 and schedule a complete overhaul of your logistics today :) In 22:00 (or less), with just 3 bridges (or less) and almost no additional tunnels your delivery and production speeds will increase, waiting times and wasted Power units count will go down and your bank account balance will stop fitting inside one bank :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2824741160 

Canned Food and Fish shipments seem like a reasonable price to postpone the terrible monster's arrival. Local silicon valley Microchip and Computer factories will need our attention as well, along with the Engineers autotrain and a One Way Station. 12:00, build 4 or more bridges, DNRT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2825812761 
and
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2823739311 

This week's LPT levels duo is packed with bus related adventures. Producing new Buses, recycling old Buses, establishing supply chains for your Bus factories, delivering Buses-the list goes on :) Pick your flavour of a Bus adventure-a 11:00 DNSAT complex landscape challenge by @petronille_marie or a 17:00 terraforming puzzle with no train crashes by @LittleBear and an excellent gameplay with some fine train driving you will get.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2825331204

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2826050883 

A level hand crafted to make us look for a better path to a certain destination only to find one suitable for a completely different direction :) Many track building decisions to make, even more rock formations to remove, elevated replayability levels, DNRT and 23:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2826416335 

Two sets of Hyperloop tunnels is the only connection there is for different parts of today's winner's train valley. Before we progress enough to complete certain 12-unit delivery quests and trigger terraforming, we'll have to keep these choke points in mind when building rails and scheduling trains. notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/147134e583d0effc109d0c3fb594cbbe14ba7b60.png[/img]

An array of levels by @artemiyk20 that may look simple while presenting a reasonably tough challenge :) Introducing:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2822676797

A train valley divided by an autotrain track that is the only way to connect the parts and also automagically earns additional funds at set intervals. No bridges, no tunnels and 16:40.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2822790714

A 23:20 DNSAT + DNDATT puzzle with a Disassembling Factory twist-said factory's custom recipe provides resources for almost every other industry present.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2822609166

We almost certainly can build an airport, yes :) Place at least 90 track tiles and destroy 0 or less track tiles, produce red airplanes while keeping the supply chain at maximum efficiency. 16:40.

And last but not least:

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2822760585

A DNDATT train valley that may require every LPT trick in the book to achieve a competitive time-even with timers relaxed in the most recent update by @artemiyk20 :) Build at least 4 bridges, 20:50.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821764049

A river dividing the valley in two-but this time around it is a proper bridge junction instead of separate bridge connections-with several decisions to make early that decide the lategame outcome. A very well thought out 7:30 DNSAT level, LPT'ed.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821402900 

One bridge, a tunnel, 20:00 and 280 grain hoppers to deliver. Dismantle armor and rockets, construct trucks and vans, use resulting resources to power the valley, ship even more grain into the city, restore damaged railway network parts, set up Worker deliveries to local farms and get this train valley's industry back on its feet.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2820720187 

A quickest supply run this week, Something From Nothing is a (surely :) less than 5 minutes DNDATT train valley with fast locomotives, a Disassembling Factory capable of turning yellow Buses into just as yellow Cars with an assortment of unused parts for an output as a part of a cycle of dismantling, refurbishing and reconstructing motor vehicles to better suit the needs of a nearby city and topography that further reinforces the circular movement of your trains.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2822228283 

A sequel to https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2820328539

Life on other planets is still strange :) Resource mining and processing changed both landscape and layout so much so modifying existing railway network will not be enough. Build anew, do not destroy anything of value, supply Diamonds and Artefacts to the central biodome cluster, start investigating and investing into planetside food production and look out for your expansion's terraforming consequences. 12:00, DNSAT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2820823621 

A colourful layout with relaxed Passenger Flow schedule and a 45:00 timer, Rapid River Valley is a design that keeps puzzle difficulty at a steady level. Add the objective to destroy at least 500 000 TV2$ worth of anything and advanced bridgecraft masterfully woven into local terrain in the mix and you will get a train valley that fits any time of day and goes well with any beverage :) DNRT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2821909724 

Detailed decoration combining seemingly everything Editor has, a brood of huts on chicken kegs, some kind of a financial institution run by penguins that sends TV2$ 6 000 to our account like clockwork, a spider autotrain, DNRT, a Passenger Flow network with multiple stations, many delivery quest locations... There is a lot going on in Penguin's Park and we have just 12 minutes :) 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2820356271 

The Laboratory that is big enough to need a city built around it is where our next adventure will be taking place. Resource acquisition installations and processing/supply depots to build a complicated railway junction around, a copper autotrain and a Coal mine awaiting railway connection just across the river (try delivering Bricks first), DNDATT and DNUE objectives and indeed not evil timers :) A fun train valley with intermediate goals to work out and resulting replayability.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/5cc68a3a321c7ac703aaaceadf6ed56ca2d37263.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2817767504 

A DNSAT level about having fun and succeeding; an unusual combination I'm sure, and yet 8:00 timer, accessible terrain and magical backstory make for a fine exercise. Now where does one find toads in TV2?

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2817954855 

A prequel to

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2809060550

as well as an answer to the "What would a @Bengotham DNUP level look like?" :)

A strange potato-shaped object is still smoking from reentry and Russets are already contracting us to establish the first set of railway tracks and help them build a research facility. Slower locomotives, some industries to erect, a suspicious purple tentacle sticking out of the water, a forgiving 18:00 timer. I am sure the artifact will be grateful for our assistance too :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2818575798 
Our demolition crews on a leave this time-no track tiles can be removed-so we will blow things up using Steel Slabs (not sure about the specifics here, but it is most definitely doable :) Some advanced resource and component shuffling between several Disassembling Factories later we are to have at least 1 000 000 TV2$ to our name and less than 7:00 on the timer.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2818786518 
Tater Town is about to become world's rocket science capital and we're here to facilitate the transition. Reconnect the islands, build around the purple guest from the deep, mind the Pass Limiter charging times and get potatoes and diamonds coming! 5 or more bridges, 170 or more track tiles, 13 minutes and a stealthy quest marker behind your locomotives list. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2820305840 
A train valley boasting an underwater section with separate access and Passenger Flow deliveries connecting two parts from the very start; a quite challenging 22 minutes long DNRT ride that has a little bit of, well, everything-from Disassembling Factories to Pass Limiters, Buggies, Toll Stations and flying submarines :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2820328539 
Alien, very colourful and ours for the taking, Alien Sea is a train valley set on a very alien yet strangely welcoming planet. Full with resources to process and introduce into our production chains, pink passages and purple hills to support our railway tracks and several small settlements waiting to buy our entire stock. Our demolition crew couldn't make it, 11:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819654055 
Nuclear kaiju monster trucks from the deep in a terrorizing seaside city scenario with high speed train deliveries and terraforming events? Destroy at least 1 100 000 TV2$ worth of stuff and blow up at least 5 trains objectives are there too :) I've already said too much, but know that King Of The Monster Trucks is a wonderful puzzle built on top of a very unusual premise using many new objects and industries, with different choices to make and enjoyment to be had. 16:30, very replayable.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819743994 
Welcome To The Machine with undetermined programming and output that apparently can be upgraded to run more efficiently. Navigate numerous moving parts and exercise caution with engine purchases and upgrades-the machine's mysterious creators/owners probably won't overlook even minor damage. 12:00, Passenger Flow mechanics and a super expensive octopus shortcut.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2818337726 
An industrial complex that runs on Steel Slabs and some Power yet is able to produce almost every kind of product and resource there is... Be it alchemy, magic or alien tech, our job is rather simple-build, connect, schedule, earn 1 200 000 TV2$ in under 18:00 and do not ask questions :) 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2817635572 
Terraforming events at 17:30 and 18:00, at least 3 tunnels to build, hidden hyperloop connections, Passenger Flow mechanics, a Pass Limiter station, 25 minutes on the timer and highly detailed, top notch surroundings to navigate, explore and overcome are waiting for us in New Babylon. An amalgamation of biomes, aesthetics, industry types and mechanics crafted into a wonderful train puzzle.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819697388 
Last stop of our today's wild ride is back on Earth by the looks of it-we're helping with supplying local farmers' market and a couple businesses with fresh produce. Our only real obstacle seems to be that Pass Limiter with 3 charges and long recharge times, but we'll find out in a minute that actually finding an optimal approach and designing your track system (along with that 65 000 TV2$ demolition job budget) is paramount. An expertly built level and a very well composed puzzle.

Allow us to extend our collective congratulations on winning the Level Of The Week award to @Gatebase! A €10 Steam gift card will be delivered by our contact ASAP.

notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/8579bfeeb368b089eea6f728300eb86b50faa99b.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816268004 

A snowy valley in the middle of June, with terraforming, shortcuts appearing and disappearing, mammoths minding their business and diamond industry growing steadily-but not without our help :) 9:00, no demolition jobs available, pleasant surroundings to look at and build around.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2814804837 

An island with every food industry out there and an unstoppable Chocolate factory with seemingly limitless supply. Autotrains, flying cars, colleagues from a neighbouring star system, different recipes and tons of quests to complete with just 10 minutes on the timer and a 160 track tiles limit. Colourful design with newest mechanics and decorations + familiar gameplay.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816474068 

A trademark Disassembling Factory with many vehicle producing industries and locomotives on a slower side @Thomas level. 10 minutes on the timer, no turning trains around and 3 wrong deliveries requirement. Deceptively simple, objectively fun :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816920723 

A DNP train driving puzzle with emphasis on no pause and train driving part :) Embargo and Toll stations to dial the difficulty to 11 and an out of our view shortcut to confuse us further, Spirited Away is an multifaceted adventure with several layers of difficulty and backstory, possibly including some Shinto-Buddhist folklore too. We get to visit the Temple of the Potato, set up Gold deliveries through the Sacred Mountains and into the Fertile Islands-in under 14:00 and without destroying a single track tile.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2816956730 

Sometimes things don't work out, and today we get to recoup some of our investments before starting anew somewhere else. We need to salvage everything of value and construct a colony ship while sustaining periodic meteor bombardment-every 4 minutes to be precise. Keep our engineers safe, do not build more than 2 bridges or tunnels. We have 18 minutes.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2814686306
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2817330328 

How can the first railway line on a certain flat disc-shaped world carried by a space-faring turtle be connected to waste management? We just don't know :) We do know however that whichever edition you pick, The Great A'Tuin proves to be a fine design-both from visual and gameplay standpoints, deploying Myths And Rails mechanics and decorations to deliver a wonderful 15:00 DNUP/17:00 and no train crashing experience.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2818176603 

We're given 20 seconds as the new Urban Planner to assess the situation before an endless stream of Workers autotrains commences. Reconnect the Power, explore the premises and get to work-build at least 10 bridges, deliver at least 300 trains, spend less than 28 minutes and fund every construction project there is. An exciting race against time with quite a bit of train management.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2815109217 

Everything is under control, HQ-the giant skeleton found in local cyan waters is almost certainly out of commission, extensive geyser system constantly testing limits of our biodomes reliably prevents any mining efforts, harsh conditions are present around the clock, purple tinged fish fingers supply plainly refuse to end and there is a 10 minutes delay for every supply ship. Both the Hyperloop and Buggy factory are still operational and so is your starting locomotive. 10 minutes, failure is not listed as an option.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2815575827 

Clever terraforming and an array of Pass Limiter stations-choose a path, eventually come to a realization that it is not the most optimal one, restart :) An original take on many paths to same set of objectives design paradigm with new station type, an intricately constructed challenge with expertly decorated and coloured terrain. 8:00 and absolutely no track demolishing + a TV2$ 1000 budget for non-track demolition jobs.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/78d0136bad71bf621777a0d205d6d876b3022e8f.png[/img]
The extra level design contest packed with new Myths And Rails industries and mechanics is over and we are ready to announce three winning levels and start sending out rewards :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2818337726

What if I told you that with a small initial investment of Steel Plates you can start a self-sufficient supply chain with many different output resources and goods that does not need any additional resupply? Thanks to TV2 Disassembling Factories ™ technology any aspiring train puzzle enthusiast can have a set up like that ready in under 18:00 in almost any conditions-including Avoid Train Crashes-and looking at estimated income of up to 1 200 000 TV2$ ! Order a Perpetual Resource Machine kit today with your nearest TV2 Workshop representative!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2819743994

Fine tuning a complex mechanism of unknown origin powered by a Potato Power Plant ™ - with many connected moving parts, Disassembling Factories, Pass Limiter stations and some Passenger Flow deliveries on top, limited building space and intricate yet thoroughly detailed layout. Special care needs to be taken not to disturb fragile components of the machine with additional engines or upgrading existing ones. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2814370606 

Last chance to build a snowman and drive some trains in the snow, Although It Is Spring is a doughnut-shaped train puzzle boasting a One Way station, a Disassembling Factory, a Pass Limiter and a bit of a terraforming surprise. At least 5 bridges to build, no train crashes, 17:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2814322817 

Deep space colony urban development with low gravity train deliveries! Unknown metal discovery demands immediate investigation by means of AI-equipped reconnaissance vehicles to be built planetside. Then there's expanding the colony to be supported by resupply and construction vehicles. Multiple pricey construction projects, bleeding edge space tech, 70:00 timer, no railway track deletion allowed, hyperloop and Pass Limiter installations present.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2811695650

Back up local truckers with a strong railway network-there's no turning your trains back on the way to profit and prosperity. No wrong deliveries either, as well as no working around Customs or building a Pass Limiter connected to even more Customs :) 11:00, three separate delivery quest locations, expensive construction projects, building materials somehow made of yellow automobiles :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812860867 

Another offworld settlement in need of transportation upgrades. Kimberlite mines are working around the clock and cannot keep up with the demand, the colony demands more ground vehicles, personnel, tools and processed metals. We are limited by 140 track tiles and 18 minutes flat, but estimated profits of at least 3 800 000 TV2$ will keep us motivated :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812577389 

[i]Boil'em, mash'em, stick'em in a stew.[/i]
Even terraforming worms couldn't say no to that-so much so that local potato fields are completely overrun and fortified against track laying attempts. We are to produce and deliver significant explosive torches supplies to combat the infestation, take back local Power Plant AND keep local businesses running and resupplied. 14:00, no turning your trains back and no demolition jobs-we're trying a stealthy approach :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2811932683 

Passenger Flow that familiar-looking colourful train valley to fund new railway junctions and fuel local industries output to turn that railway roundabout into a super efficient and highly profitable complex. 11:11, no wrong deliveries and still no demolition allowed. Pay no attention to the cows :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2812612956 

In just 8 minutes we'll work through a Pass Limiter, Buggy shortage, illegally high Toll Station rates, two tunnels limit, a Warehouse filled with Steel Slabs and a One Way Station that isn't big on making friends :) Look out for local terrain's peculiarities and use provided locomotives without crashing any. A lot to deliver and even more to plan ahead in order to meet the Quick Quota.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/5a6482e7578397eb56dd3d7ce0d57197df2d8a44.png[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2811419867 

Out in the sea one cannot find no demolition crews. No train reversing.
Oh, but all manners of adventure await us there-a sandworm that's a bit lost, marshmallow-riding octopuses guarding an underwater facility, secret Cyber Crystal factories and explosions among other things. A 15:00 valley designed to test one's ingenuity :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2810811315 

A fast 9:10 DNSAT adventure-diamonds, secret perfume ingredient and fine landscaping with intertwining junctions to build and some mistakes to be made along the way. No wrong deliveries, LPT'ed :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2809705402 

Definitely no faster routes to be found on your 7th playthrough of this one :) Production operation of a certain iconic dish is in need of some serious scaling up and delivering ingredients by a trainload is what we're after today. No engine upgrades and a 3 bridge limit will only warm our puzzle solving skills up. 11:40, look out for that power plant eating all your potatoes.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2809422619 

DNRT 35:00 long haul-we are tasked with automating a rocket base by producing complex robots while constructing a cruise liner port and handling tourists visiting the base. Plan carefully-no demolition job slots available-and act fast, for the Space Age does not wait.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2809357822 

Nothing like a little bit of smuggling in the morning :) Diamonds seem to be the new craze and we're going to move a lot-after swapping the diamonds used in the jewelry with glass stones-through that Pass Limiter station, timing departures to avoid raising suspicion. Might as well make at least a 1 000 000 TV2$ deposit to our bank account while dealing with local terraforming-toting outlaws. DNSAT, 15:00.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2809060550 

We've been told our next contractor is a little bit...eccentric. Mentioning some kind of...third party that has recently arrived and requires their utmost attention. We are to establish an efficient railroad network for rapidly expanding local businesses with as little hustle and distraction as possible-no wrong deliveries and most certainly no train crashes. Don't go asking too much about local alchemical shop preferred potion ingredient and ignore the whole giant squid wrestling a ship business too :) 18:00, bzzzt!

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2810332021

Just don't ask where your food comes from...and go along with wonderful new recipes calling for strange looking but totally harmless and super edible alien eggs! Same eggs we get Coal and Sand out of you say?...
Timed terraforming events keep you on alert, admiring great landscaping and colouring gets in the way of track planning, and bonus 19:30 timer, DNRT objective and updated water add to replayability value of Magical Eggs train puzzle :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2811286767

The city of Therum calls for a good industrialist, and TV2 community shall answer! We're here to upgrade local logistics network with latest railway tech and help satisfy the ever growing population's demands. Building around luxurious skyscrapers, spending small fortunes on power plants, handling two autotrain deliveries and looking at a 35:00 timer every 30 minutes or so is what Industrial Metropolis is about :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808838136 

[i]Nothing's free in Waterworld.[/i]
A locomotive fleet in need of upgrades, several key industries waiting for construction funds and dry land in high demand-this train valley is still on its way to economic expansion and industrial growth. A very welcome blend of advanced design/decorations placement and vanilla evenly-paced gameplay. 18:00, no wrong deliveries please. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2808738939 

Modern dragons require modern tributes-and Cyber Crystals and Artifacts to make usual Gold and Diamonds more appealing is a start. Construct the mines deep in the fairy forest, avoid damaging the trees and keep the Pass Limiter and the 8:45 timer in mind. A colourful fairytale about paying your taxes on time set in mythical lands with diesel powered locomotives, giant mushrooms and a dragon-owned fortress on a mountain :)

Congratulations on your well-deserved award @Sugarstar! A €10 Steam gift card will be delivered by our contact ASAP.

The government set up a secure perimeter, checkpoints and a research center to gain complete control over alien artifacts, personnel and knowledge. notes.title: Even more production buildings coming to Train Valley 2
notes.notes:
Thank you for your continuing support and your feedback and creativity. As a token of our gratitude, we have some more top secret data about Train Valley 2 newest content expansion:

Please welcome the [b]Disassembling Factory:[/b]

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/d2071fde256da871362e26552be5e13dd4afc362.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/d2071fde256da871362e26552be5e13dd4afc362.png[/img][/url]

Quick facts:

[list]
[*] A single incoming resource or product is disassembled into corresponding components.
[*] Initial resource as well as resulting components capacity is limited and can be defined in the Editor.
[*] A Disassembling Factory can produce up to 5 [b]different[/b] components.
[*] Disassembling process may require Workers and/or Electricity-this is optional and can be enabled through the Editor's Object Settings screen.
[*] No Electricity refunds.
[*] Players can follow any recipe or blueprint or let their fantasy free and dismantle candy into Steel and  Fish (see the screenshot above :)
[*] A Disassembling Factory will not process more of the incoming product before components from the previous batch are shipped elsewhere.
[*] Players can choose components for transportation by switching between the Disassembling Factory output options with Left Mouse Button. [i]In the screenshot above we can click Fish to switch the output, and later can click Steel Plates to go back to delivering those. [/i]
[*] A Disassembling Factory can be used in several Scenarios and trigger Activables across the level. Stay tuned for an update to our [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2583543862]Activables guide![/url] 
[/list]

We are looking forward to meeting you during this Friday's[url=https://discord.com/invite/train-valley] LPT challenge![/url] Good luck!

notes.title: New Station types coming to Train Valley 2
notes.notes:
Another week-another preview!

We give you the[b] Pass Limiter[/b] station:

[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/b121ebdf514e7360a181bf3b02adf3f8db7d0f50.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/b121ebdf514e7360a181bf3b02adf3f8db7d0f50.png[/img][/url]
[i]Complemented with armor on alert as well as some new cargo types :)[/i]

Quick facts:

[list]
[*] A Pass Limiter station lets trains through in both directions-without a toll.
[*] Every passing train uses 1 Pass Limiter charge.
[*] After all charges have been used up, a Pass Limiter becomes unavailable for a certain amount of time-until it recharges.
[*] A Pass Limiter can be recharged unlimited number of times.
[*] While recharging a Pass Limiter will not let trains through and will reverse any incoming train's direction automatically-no explosions or money loss.
[*] Both recharging times and number of charges can be defined in the Editor.
[/list]

Do you have any level ideas for this new station already? Tell us in the comment section, and we are looking forward to meeting you during this Friday's[url=https://discord.com/invite/train-valley] LPT challenge![/url] Good luck!

Nearly 1800 Workshop levels and approximately 240 Let's Play Together challenges later the time has come to choose a level worthy of the Level Of The Year 2021 title. It goes without saying that picking a single Workshop submission out of many, many wonderful train valleys is...problematic. 

During the course of 2021 with your valuable feedback in mind we have added new objects and mechanics to the game, some still available only in Workshop levels. We are bringing these never-before-used by our level design team mechanics back with another official campaign as well as improving on these ideas and introducing brand new objects, buildings, stations-some are making their way into Train Valley 2 very soon. All that would not be possible without you and your unfailing interest in train puzzles. Flazm Interactive would like to express gratitude to every Train Valley player. You all are brilliant.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2461727621

[i]A process or method through the application of which one attempts to understand through deductive reasoning how a device, process, system, or piece of software accomplishes a task with very little (if any) insight into exactly how it does so. [/i]

A fine example of our player's ingenuity that indeed resulted in a new building soon to be introduced to the Editor, Reverse Engineering by @ishKiia is a story of betrayal, hostile takeover, power play among car factory owners, some questionable business practices, heavy duty train deliveries and disassembling ready to ship cars into basic components, smuggling resulting components through many Customs stations filled with officials that are not prepared for a heist of that scale and reassembling cars using smuggled resources after. A complex multistage procedure on its own, while done in reverse requires exponentially more processing power :)

A quaint grasslands valley landscape divided by a waterway suggests several stages to this operation, limited space dictates any crazy track layout you can come up with is the way to go. 15 minutes, Do Not Reverse Trains and Do Not Allow Any Train To Arrive At The Wrong Station. You do have fastest engines from the start.

@ishKiia, outstanding work! A €50 Steam gift card is heading your way right now :)

Train Valley 2 community and developers want you, reader, to bring out your level editor and show us train driving complexity levels we never knew even existed. Build, create, [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/602320/discussions/1/1640912759106326420/]compete[/url]. Having fun is a requirement :)

notes.title: New production buildings coming to Train Valley 2
notes.notes:
Another week, another bit of information about the next content update for Train Valley 2.

[b]Meet the Warehouse:[/b]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/1f96076a060ccc59b993ff1471035de5beb22e6d.png[/img]

Quick facts:

[list]
[*] A Warehouse can store a single type of resources or goods predefined within the Editor.
[*] Delivering trains to a Warehouse will not earn you money.
[*] Stored resources can be delivered from a Warehouse to another production building with a train at any time.
[*] Quantity of resources that can be stored is predefined within the Editor too.
[*] Storage services are provided for free and with no time limit.
[*] No, storing Electricity is not allowed.
[/list]

Tune in for even more updates on Train Valley 2's upcoming DLC and godspeed during this Friday's LPT challenge!

notes.title: Weekly Winner - December 20th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/9ab313cf6e6003ca9819b75c68e9e24b8686acca.png[/img]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2680993839 

There is keeping track of all your locomotives (see what I did here?), then there's microcontrolling everything possible simultaneously, and then there is Some Trickery — LPT veteranship, known tricks usage are mandatory, getting 5 stars form the get-go isn't :) DNSAT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681187026 

Santa Visits Safariland to take their mind of all things festive and had a great time. Many biomes, more animals, story-rich gameplay, funds to accrue and bridges to construct, time objectives to meet and truly trademark terrain configuration to explore.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681990208 

DNUP vanilla-styled train valley, offerings to the spirits to increase crop yields, possible terraforming complications as well as almost no time to dawdle :) Be careful and do not anger the spirit.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2686014510 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2686851625 

Don't let a bit simpler layout style make you relax, for both valleys are a challenge. Multibranch supply chains and intertwined junctions make petronille_marie's latest Workshop submissions shine, especially in the case of Xmas Again with additional DNSAT and DNDATT.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2686019661 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2687224719 

Be it the archipelago valley or a certain dualist medieval religious organization themed level, the gameplay will be both relatively relaxing and keep us interested, give us some slack and make us look at the secondary objectives panel time after time, and certainly will be enjoyable in both getting all the stars and restarting :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2687403373 

24 Customs Stations, Christmas at our collective doorstep, extra busy and extra inefficient officers taking all the time there is to process the goods and documentation, unfazed even by terraforming events happening left and right. A true nightmare for any locomotive operator with a trainload of delivery orders running late, CUSTOMSized Christmas Calendar is here to overthrow Best From The Workshop tab previous occupants :)  

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2681623321 

[i]Try not to crash and get the deliveries right
And you'll earn five stars on this dark Christmas night.[/i]

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2685962873

Use the hyperloops, control your funds flow and celebrate together with Round.

Elevated Christmas themed levels relevance provides us with seemingly unending supply of snowy train valleys with booming Christmas tree and chocolate presents industries with sporadic penguin incursions and every festive paraphernalia sprinkled on top. No extra difficulty modifiers like DNSAT, just a lot of urgent deliveries across complex landscapes to help out Santa where a track laying puzzle transforms - with time - into a compact railroad tycoon game, where a player has to oversee every move yet can have a nice cup of tea while doing so.

A map to relax. No tricks, easy goals, and a little terraforming triggered with timber deliveries. 25 minutes, a sneaky One Way Station, almost familiar island in the middle of a body of water layout and quite some bridge construction projects ahead.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2675849473 

A DNSAT mission to save the world from an unknown virus starts with a couple of engines and several well-hidden terraforming events. A busy suburban area packed with industries, a quarantined city, unavailable demolishing team and 19 minutes to expand, build, complete, succeed.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2680616444 

A complete change of direction from a chill evenly paced gameplay commenced by the previous DNSAT nominee, The Warehouse Strategy has an uncommon build and accrue now - deliver and distribute later dynamic set up by several terraforming events that open up an access point to the city way later in the game - at 7.00, 14.00 and 21.00 minutes. Demolition team still on vacation, 23 minutes time limit, busy megapolis streets to navigate and an ATT objective - replayability is assured with both original design and difficulty levels :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2675428851

Giant snowflakes are an immediate threat to this snow valley, and hyperloop connections are our only chance. 35 Passenger Flow trains aside this is a battle against time, funds shortage and impulse to run a locomotive through a snowman.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2669211043 
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2671519052 

Highly detailed layout, many places to visit, even more delivery quests to complete and few restraints or secondary objectives that can slow us down - this level duo is perfect for getting your Christmas a bit more train-y and puzzl-y :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2669868481 

A simple level in winter-y colours, Blue has track tile limit, a tricky bridge placement problem, compact layout but only 20 minutes of having a blast overcoming all that.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2670634512 

Fastest locomotives, carte blanche to build all the tunnels and bridges, 27 minutes to explore and at least 40 different quests to complete! Sure, Christmas isn't coming tomorrow, but we might as well begin preparations :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2670281648

notes.title: Weekly Winner - November 8th
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/1f2fe389397663b7a4768c9d4524de8f78744464.png[/img]
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2643124711 

A (maybe) quick and simple one, Alta Vista is a terraforming-flavoured story of perseverance, under 10 minutes financial gains, top-shelf junction planning and locomotive driving delivering goods multitasking. Send the first load of ore to Alta Vista and...

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2645238338 

...find out that Alta Vista still has allies — the city of Cascade decided to use its tremendous industrial capacity and technical talent and send necessary supplies in. No easy task, for Alta Vista's less neighbourly neighbours will try and stop us. So will terrain, various bodies of water, terraforming, a 500 trains delivered objective and Chomps — a riveting two part story.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2647380263

Learn the premises, objectives, starting funds amount and locomotive fleet, build junctions, a bridge to connect two sides and avoid expensive demolishing orders, drive through DNSAT and tight timers while calculating deliveries schedule. Get 5 stars and start again :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2648600839 

Remember, remember the 5th of November. 
Explosions! Controlled explosions that open new areas and upgrade our deliveries schedule. Colourful surroundings, tricky intersections, 15 minutes timer and a delightful locomotive puzzle to celebrate Guy Fawkes Day. 

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2647582200 

Dismantle everything including a vast supply of old cars of unknown or suspicious origin, repurpose airdropped tools, recycle resulting raw materials and construct brand new cars, all in a 20 minutes' work. A balanced puzzle that can be played many times and completed almost every one :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2645904729
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2646565241

Spiders. If Train Valley 2 taught us anything, it is that spiders are mysterious, highly intelligent, resourceful creatures with unclear motives. Powerful allies, brilliant engineers, prime potion (and chocolate!) ingredient — there is nothing spiders cannot do. Arachnid Pass and Spider Diplomacy tell a story of a spider clan that lives in a mountain spider city and performs arcane spider rituals and excavation jobs, for a price — very extravagant jewellery in particular. DNDATT, engine limit, terraforming events and shared geography make both entries equally enjoyable. Is this a start of a series? We hope it is.

@eijolend thank you for bringing us these levels! A €10 Steam gift card will be delivered to them by our contact ASAP.

Two levels to test our hand/eye coordination and multitasking — driving all the trains simultaneously while calculating and recalculating many supplies for deliveries while planning our next construction job while peeking nervously at the 5-start timer :) Industry requires us to earn 5 000 000 TV2$ and build no tunnels; Industry Too amps up the pace threefold level creator claims — you need to earn just 3 000 000 TV2$ but deliver no less than 500 trains — a challenge no TV2 practitioner can pass up :)

Also restock and maintain a supply chain in Train Valley 2's recent Workshop level to produce said devices and distribute them to local electronics outlets. Generous timers, engine set that is — before the upgrades — more about style than speed, plenty of space to lay down the tracks, premium priced construction projects, and no DNRT or DNSAT :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2626260664

Use the northern tunnel, keep the timers readings close, beat the level in one go :)

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2629058901

Multiple terraforming events, track tile limit, mysterious castle on a hill and complete absence of logistics of any kind. Unfortunately pumpkins won't walk themselves to the factory, so two engines will not suffice. A fabled city in the sands is waiting for us to find the key.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2608979526 

Burning waste caused multiple fissures around the valley, isolating cities and production buildings. Get rid of the molten trash, rebuild the rails, work around the terraforming and don't forget about the DNRT. 15 minutes and 5 engines limit.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2609578020 

A terraforming story of electric locomotives and magic successfully ELPT'ed and thoroughly adored, Turn is colourful and captivating tale of why one should not mix technology and witchcraft, for it leads to grounds shifting, cities and productions sites getting cut off, requirement for additional - and expensive - tunnels and bridges appearing — spawning every kind of railroad puzzle complication there is.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2607932728 

[i]A cowpybara that goes by Dai is off to have some deserved shut-eye. Help it or stop it or send it away — a cowpybara's memory will catch up one day.[/i]
DNDATT and do not destroy anything worse more than 1 TV2$ — 18 minutes, complex potion brewing machinery, beautiful surroundings and a story of possible betrayal and very much certain highspeed train chase to follow.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2610293568 

One of the greatest terraforming scenarios showcases what one can do with just a couple of water activables and a great idea. Fixing pump stations brings bodies of water down revealing new ways to connect the industries and the bridge limit keeps our vast railroad network from spreading too much. Rebuilding previously constructed junctions is the way to optimize the trainflow, and time and engine count limits spice the logistics problem up nicely too.

@Striker700 is our newest winner! A €10 Steam gift card will be delivered to them by our contact ASAP.

Don't forget to tell us about your TV2 workshop adventures and visit our Discord server for an upcoming LPT challenge. Until next week!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/28520888/99ee70bff1aeee478b059e581b5c85c16d424fde.png[/img]
Level of the Month - August 2021 - Highspeed Train Racing Strategy Edition :)

It's a race against time, low funds and well-hidden shortcuts, both financial and geographical. Toll stations that earn you money, pit stops that earn you money but require time investment, rail track system that is built not for delivering to and from but for running your engines in a loop, train valley where speeding up time is a vital tool and DNSAT + DNDATT objectives are not our biggest concern.

Welcome to Cars Race.

https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2587387472

Racing is a very competitive sport, and than there is train racing while delivering fresh off the conveyor race cars - with puzzles/pit stops and upgrading racing track to acquire fresh fuel and even more prize funds. Master the circuit and get the cars delivered ASAP. Unusual, interesting, refreshing experience.

Congratulations @Miaxlo, your €30 Steam gift card is on its way!

Train Valley 2 community and developers want you, reader, to bring out your level editor and show us train driving complexity levels we never knew even existed. Build, create, compete. Having fun is a requirement.
